entries.name: 悬刃
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a mature cinematic 2D side-view vertical action game. Generate a single landscape atlas, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows, six isolated full body poses of the SAME character facing RIGHT in strict side view. Hand-painted gothic dark fantasy, fine etched cloth and metal textures with clear value separation and pale warm rim light, painterly but sharp readable silhouette. Ground-level orthographic camera. Each pose centered in its equal cell, identical anatomical scale, generous 12% empty margins, entire head feet weapon and cloth visible inside cell. No text, no grid lines, no scenery, no ground shadow, no glow cloud, no motion trails. Genuine transparent background. All six poses different and anatomically believable, weighted hips and feet. Do not resemble a robot, cartoon child, stick figure, or the red scarf plague doctor hero. Subject: A lean floating knife assassin, long desaturated ivory scarf split into two narrow tails, charcoal fitted layered cloth, faceless narrow bone mask and wrapped boots, small throwing knives at belt, clearly organic body. Same assassin in six different poses: row 1 calm hovering with legs hanging; drifting sideways with knees flexed; twisting torso drawing a knife back. Row 2 whipping knife arm forward with cloth following; recovering balance after throwing; recoiling sideways from a hit, arms guarding. No separate flying projectiles.

entries.prompt: Edit reference: preserve the exact identity, costume, materials and painterly rendering of the martial assassin in the attached atlas: oxblood cropped tunic, dark wrapped trousers, bronze half mask, black tied-back hair, bare upper arms, short curved blade in right hand. Create a NEW production transparent animation atlas, exactly TWO columns ONE row. Both full body, same scale and feet baseline, facing RIGHT in side view. LEFT: coiled elbow strike anticipation: rear foot planted, hip turned away, left forearm folded across chest, right short blade held down close to hip. RIGHT: forceful close-range left elbow strike: front knee bent, hips and torso rotated forward, left elbow driven forward toward an opponent's chest, forearm still folded sharply, right blade kept close to body. Elbow visibly leads the motion, NOT a sword swing or extended fist. Mature gothic hand-painted game art, anatomically plausible, warm rim highlights, no text, no glows, no floor, no shadows, no second character. Real transparent alpha, generous empty margins, neither silhouette crosses its cell.
